_notes: Values name env vars that hold Foundry deployment names, so swapping
models is an app-setting change, not a deploy.
Suggested mapping: CHEAP=Haiku-4.5 or gpt-5-mini class, STANDARD=Sonnet-5
or gpt-5 class, PREMIUM=Opus-5 class (weekly digests only).
Triage runs on every capture — that is where cheap routing pays for itself.
